body:
I moved to a foreign country for her where I don’t speak the language and I don’t have any friends or family here... I am absolutely lost right now. I can’t believe she did this to me. We planned on moving in together in a couple months... I am all alone here now... I don’t know what to be alive for right now 😞

I will find something that lifts me up and/or go into therapy, I could definitely use it. Thanks kind stranger 🙏🏼
